i am unable to login to oppe vm please help

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
Please don’t create multiple posts for same question. You need to paste your ssh key on the oppe-room-2 portal.

Follow these steps -
cd .ssh
ls
You will see here either id_ed25519.pub or id_rsa.pub

Based on the file you see do either -
cat id_ed25519.pub
OR
cat id_rsa.pub

Copy its contents and paste it on the portal and then do ssh with your roll number.

If you are unable to login join support meet at 9 pm. Link in the calendar.
